title: Discord channel list reorganized
summary: The Discord channel list was reordered and five channels were moved to the archived category.
description: The November 8, 2026 audit records channel position changes and an explicit archive move for the older FAQ. The server owner also confirmed four more channels archived that day.

body.text: The audit shows position updates across help, community, updates, support, staff, and download channels. These shifts include addons, mechanics, known-problems, installing-worlds, beta-news, chat, interface, updates, suggestions, game-chat, console, whitelists, guide, FAQ, support, worlds, and schematics. The position values in the audit were intermediate changes during the reordering, not a durable final order.
